welcome_message:
EDP use-case bundle scaffold
----------------------------
Creates a new use-case bundle with the standard four targets, the standard
variable set, a curated + datamart job pair, and the two-zone src/ layout
(ported/ and <use_case>_module/).

Parity reconciliation is NOT generated here - it is owned by QA and lives in
bundles/recon. Step 6 below covers it.

Run from the repo root:

    databricks bundle init ./templates/use-case-bundle --output-dir bundles

Then see docs/04-bundle-authoring.md.

use_case.description: Use case name in lower snake_case (e.g. us6). Becomes the folder name, the bundle name suffix, the Python package name AND the schema name in all three data catalogs.
use_case.pattern_match_failure_message: Must be lower snake_case, 2-31 characters, starting with a letter. It becomes a Unity Catalog schema name, so no hyphens or dots.

owning_team.description: Azure AD group owning this use case. Used in permissions and CODEOWNERS.

domain.description: Primary business entity, singular lower case (e.g. orders, claims). Names the sample tables.

landing_source.description: Where this use case lands from. Adds the matching config to the SHARED landing bundle.

success_message:
Created bundles/{{.use_case}}.

Next, IN THIS ORDER:
  1. Add the schemas to the _platform bundle - three files:
       bundles/_platform/resources/schemas_landing.yml
       bundles/_platform/resources/schemas_curated.yml
       bundles/_platform/resources/schemas_datamart.yml
     plus an owner_{{.use_case}} variable in bundles/_platform/variables.yml
     and volumes in bundles/_platform/resources/volumes.yml.
     WITHOUT THIS THE BUNDLE HAS NOWHERE TO WRITE.
  2. Add bundles/landing/conf/{{.use_case}}/sources.yml and
     bundles/landing/resources/landing_{{.use_case}}.job.yml.
  3. Add to CODEOWNERS: /bundles/{{.use_case}}/, the landing conf folder,
     and bundles/recon/conf/{{.use_case}}.yml.
  4. Copy .azure-pipelines/cd-us1.yml to cd-{{.use_case}}.yml and change the
     three lines that differ (name, bundlePath, runAfterDeploy).
  5. Register the pipeline, or re-run scripts/setup/Az-DevOps-Bootstrap.ps1.
  6. Ask QA to add bundles/recon/conf/{{.use_case}}.yml and
     bundles/recon/resources/recon_{{.use_case}}.job.yml. A use case with no
     parity definition cannot be signed off for cutover.
  7. Deploy your sandbox:
       pwsh ./scripts/dev/Deploy-Sandbox.ps1 -Bundle {{.use_case}}

The cross-reference audit fails until step 4 is done - deliberately, so a
bundle cannot exist with no way to deploy it.
